verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at help.thoropass.com (HTTP 200) with a structured index of help-center articles. Help articles are also served as Markdown (.md URLs, e.g. the MCP connection guide and Unified Controls articles), so an agent can ingest the docs directly. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or full-content dump, llms.txt is scoped to the help center rather than the main product/site, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of agent usage.
